notes.title: Lighting Update Based on Player Feedback
notes.content:
[p]Based on the valuable feedback and suggestions from our players, we have made significant improvements to the in-game lighting system.[/p][list][*][p]Increased brightness in overly dark areas.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted shadows that were blocking visibility.[/p][/*][*][p]Maintained the atmosphere while improving clarity and playability.[/p][/*][/list][p]Our goal is to keep the dark and tense atmosphere of [i]The Deathmind[/i] while making it easier for you to explore the story and environment in detail. Your feedback means a lot to us. Please keep sharing your thoughts!


[b]Our New Steam Logo is Here!
[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45685075/8c6c569ffdf4abc067d9cfc7836f3de3f33b5650.jpg"][/img]
Our new logo has been designed to reflect the game’s dark atmosphere and psychological thriller theme in a stronger way.

[/p]
